test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

The gentleman had a suitcase full with wigs, ornaments and dresses.
solution:
The correct answer is **a suitcase full with**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Full with'** should be replaced by ' **full of'**.
 
• The use of the preposition '**of **is appropriate here. 
 
• **Full of: **To a complete extent; entirely.
 
 
• **Example: **This museum is **full of** pictures and sculptures.
 
 
 
• Thus, the option which contains a grammatical error is **option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The gentleman had a suitcase full of wigs, ornaments and dresses.*
